text:
Iris: :wave: Kickoff — ACME just asked for a private pilot with a burst SLA and prewarm behavior by May. Need to align scope, who owns what, and launch gating. @Devon @Samir @Ally @Priya
Devon: Do we have concrete acceptance criteria from the customer? We need numbers to scope engineering work.
Iris: They want low-latency generative calls for their UI. Rough asks: p95 < 150ms for small prompts, prewarm to ~100 concurrent sessions within ~30s, and an SLA for burst availability.
Samir: Runtime note — to hit that we need KV cache warm paths + dedicated pool + smarter batching. I estimate 2 runtime engineers for 3 sprints to implement prewarm + canary hooks.
Ally: Infra perspective — VPC + reserved capacity + routing rules. We'll need an infra ticket for capacity reservations and billing impact (~$7k/mo estimate). Also need to carve a staging slice for canary.
Priya: Security: customer requires KMS/HSM key integration for tenant keys and a short pen test + data residency checklist. That typically adds one sprint for integrations and signoff.
Iris: OK tradeoffs: we can either drop target to p95 < 250ms or push pilot date by 3-4 weeks. Also consider fallback to hosted API for surge to avoid failure. Thoughts?
Devon: Fallback is fine — route overflow to hosted model variant with degraded SLA. We need a per-tenant rollout flag and an automated routing policy. Runtime + infra need a rollout config.
Samir: Also flag: model quantization choice matters. Using q4/awq reduces cost but we must run quality evals to avoid regressions for ACME's prompts. That adds a small validation task.
Iris: For roadmap gating I propose three must-haves before pilot signoff: 1) Launch Acceptance doc (prod + sec) 2) Resourcing commit (runtime x2, infra x1, security x1, product owner) 3) 3-week canary with metrics and automatic rollback. Who volunteers to own each?
Ally: I’ll own infra checklist and the capacity reservation ticket.
Priya: I’ll own security checklist and coordinate pen test scheduling.
Devon: Runtime acceptance and canary plan — Samir and I will own that together.
Samir: I'll draft the runtime checklist and prewarm test harness.
Iris: Great. Action items:
- Iris: create Launch Acceptance doc and share by EOD Tue (1725338925)
- Ally: open infra ticket for reserved capacity + cost estimate by Thu
- Priya: sec checklist + timeline by Thu
- Devon/Samir: runtime acceptance + canary runbook by next Mon
Iris: Quick decision: do we accept the customer SLA ask as-is? Vote please (thumbs up = accept, :thinking_face: = ask them to relax numbers or shift date)
Devon: :thinking_face: — prefer they relax p95 or accept canary delay.
Samir: :thumbsup: if we get the 2 engs & canary window.
Ally: :thumbsup: with upfront budget approval.
Priya: :thinking_face: until KMS timeline is confirmed.
Iris: Noted. I'll synthesize and send a single reply to ACME that outlines the tradeoffs (option A: keep SLA + later date; option B: reduce SLA + earlier pilot).
deploy-bot: scheduled canary job templates available at https://internal.redwood/tools/canary-templates — use `canary:acme` config.
Iris: Thanks everyone — I'll ping the thread when the doc is up. :lock:
